audience: Czech and Slovak freelancers and small businesses who issue invoices with Vyfakturuj

useCases.title: Review the newest invoices and their totals
useCases.text: The AI lists documents sorted newest first, with number, customer, currency, total and paid or sent flags, and opens one invoice with its items.

useCases.title: Find a customer in the address book
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts by text, ICO, DIC, name, e-mail or phone and reads one contact with billing and delivery address and default days due.

useCases.title: Check payment methods, number series and tags
useCases.text: The AI lists the payment methods, the numbering series and the tags set up in the account, with their ids.

useCases.title: Add a customer to the address book
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact with a name or company and details such as e-mail. Nothing is sent to the customer.

useCases.title: Issue an invoice for a customer
useCases.text: The AI creates an invoice with items for a contact, using a number series and payment method. It is issued at once with the next number, as there is no draft state.
